headline: Indian Emulsifiers wins Rs 111.82 Cr order from USA Customer
summary: IEML secures Rs 111.82 Cr specialty chemical order from USA Customer. This follows Rs 74.20 Cr inflow in Q2FY27. Book-to-bill context and execution trends analyzed.

stock_name: ARISTO BIO T AND LIFESC L
headline: Aristo Bio-Tech wins Rs 1.98 Cr order from DVA Agro
summary: Aristo Bio-Tech & Lifescience secured a Rs 1.98 Cr purchase order from Germany-based DVA Agro GmbH for Profenophos supply. The deal represents significant inflow relative to recent disclosures, with cash-against-delivery terms mitigating receivable risks.

headline: Kheria Autocomp wins Rs 12 Cr order from Yanfeng for MG Hector
summary: Kheria Autocomp secured a Rs 12 crore work order from Yanfeng India Automotive Interior Systems for MG Hector Tomahawk door trim parts. Execution begins April 2027.

headline: Transteel wins Rs 4.62 crore order from Vestian Global
summary: Transteel Seating receives confirmed work order for furniture supply from Vestian Global Workplace Services. Order value is Rs 461.61 lakh, classified as significant.

headline: BMISL wins Rs 6.67 Cr AI AV order from Govt
summary: Bench Mark Infotech Services secures Rs 6.67 Cr order for AI-based audio-visual systems in High Courts and Govt depts across Bihar, UP, MP. Book-to-bill ratio remains high given limited historical revenue visibility.

headline: Aerpace outlines merger rationale with Aerpace Robotics
summary: Aerpace Industries details strategic reasons for merging Aerpace Robotics, aiming to unify R&D and manufacturing. The proposed scheme involves a 102:100 share exchange ratio, subject to regulatory approvals.

headline: KFin Technologies hit with ₹10 lakh SEBI penalty
summary: SEBI imposed a ₹10 lakh penalty on KFin Technologies under Section 15HB for an RTA matter. The company stated the impact was already accounted for in FY26.

headline: Power Grid plans ₹45,000 Cr borrowing for FY27
summary: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd board to meet on November 30, 2026. Agenda includes borrowing up to ₹45,000 crore via domestic bonds and a $600 million term loan from Export Development Canada.

headline: CESC unit awards 153.7 MW wind project to Venwind Refex
summary: CESC subsidiary Purvah Green Power has awarded a 153.7 MW wind project order to Venwind Refex Power for WTG supply and end-to-end execution in Madhya Pradesh, with a 24-month completion timeline.

headline: Stocks to Watch: Wipro, Siemens Energy, CESC in focus
summary: Wipro signs major bp deal but faces Wedbush downgrade. Siemens Energy posts strong Q4 results. CESC expands renewable capacity with new orders.

headline: ACME Solar commissions 63.78 MW BESS in Rajasthan
summary: ACME Solar Holdings commissioned 63.78 MW/255.12 MWh of its NHPC FDRE project in Rajasthan on November 25, 2026. The COD is set for November 27.

headline: Welspun Corp wins Rs 2,264 crore export order for LSAW pipes
summary: Welspun Corp secured a Rs 2,264 crore export order for LSAW pipes from India operations. The order adds to a robust backlog with 6.98 quarters of coverage. Execution focus shifts to FY28 timelines.

headline: Powergrid to review ₹45,000 crore fundraising plan
summary: Power Grid Corporation plans to review a ₹45,000 crore fundraising proposal and a USD 600 million loan from EDC at its board meeting on November 30.

headline: Blue Cloud showcases AI healthcare to global mayors
summary: Blue Cloud Softech Solutions showcased BluHealth and BioSter at the World Mayors' Forum in Mumbai. The company engaged city leaders from over 100 countries, highlighting sovereign AI solutions for urban governance.

headline: Kotak keeps Sell on Wipro, target price ₹155
summary: Kotak Institutional Equities maintains a Sell rating on Wipro with a target price of ₹155. The BP mega deal is seen supporting revenue recovery, but annualised contribution is estimated at less than 70-80 bps.

headline: HSBC initiates Hold on NSE with target price ₹2300
summary: HSBC has initiated coverage on NSE with a Hold rating and a target price of ₹2300, citing strong franchise strengths but noting valuations already price in strong performance.

headline: JPMorgan keeps Overweight on Tech Mahindra, TP ₹1900
summary: JPMorgan maintains an Overweight rating on Tech Mahindra with a target price of ₹1900, citing 7% constant-currency growth expectations, a strong deal pipeline, and structural margin expansion.

headline: Jyoti Structures receives Rs 175.67 Cr LOI from Sterlite Grid
summary: Jyoti Structures received a Letter of Intent worth Rs 175.67 crore from Sterlite Grid 5 Limited. The order book coverage stands at 19.75 quarters, with recent inflows accelerating significantly.

headline: Zim Labs promoter Anwar Daud acquires shares, VRs
summary: Anwar Daud acquired 50,520 shares and voting rights in Zim Laboratories. Total holding rises to 34.29% after inter-se transfers and trust acquisitions.

headline: GMR Airports block trade of ₹184.68 crore on BSE
summary: A block trade of approximately 18,000,000 shares of GMR Airports was executed on BSE at ₹102.60 per share, aggregating to ₹184.68 crore.

headline: MTAR promoter sells 9,000 shares
summary: Mitta Madhavi, a promoter of MTAR Technologies, disclosed the sale of 9,000 equity shares in the open market on November 23, 2026.

headline: Jajodia group acquires 3.65 lakh shares in Swagtam
summary: Suresh Brahmanand Jajodia and family acquired 365,000 equity shares of Swagtam Trading & Services Ltd via preferential allotment on November 21, 2026.

headline: Fitch: loan growth, ECL to cap banks' capital ratios
summary: Fitch warns that loan growth and ECL provisions will limit upside to banks' capital ratios, projecting FY28 credit costs at 0.8% of gross loans versus a 0.6% view in FY27.

headline: Fitch flags rate rise risk and capital pressure on Indian banks
summary: Fitch expects Indian interest rates to rise amid near-term inflationary pressures, while loan growth and ECL provisions are likely to limit upside to banks' capital ratios.

headline: Persistent Systems shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged approximately 1,00,000 shares of Persistent Systems on BSE at ₹6,230.00, with a combined value of ₹62.30 crore.

headline: Aurionpro named in Forbes Asia Best Under A Billion 2026
summary: Aurionpro Solutions Ltd has been included in Forbes Asia's Best Under A Billion 2026 list, recognizing top-performing APAC companies with revenues under $1 billion.

headline: Airpro Tech IPO: ₹24.91 Cr Fresh Issue
summary: Jaipur-based Airpro Technology India Limited files DRHP for a ₹24.91 crore SME IPO. The company reported 77% revenue growth and plans to expand manufacturing capacity in Jaipur.

headline: Tata Trust challenges N Chandrasekhar reappointment at TCS
summary: Tata Trust has moved the Bombay High Court challenging the reappointment of N Chandrasekhar, in a significant corporate governance development involving Tata Consultancy Services.

headline: Rajeev Goenka HUF raises Gamco stake to 0.22%
summary: Rajeev Goenka HUF acquired 15,000 Gamco Ltd shares via open market between Nov 20-23, 2026. The promoter group holding now stands at 1,27,122 shares, or 0.22% of equity.

headline: GK Energy forms BESS subsidiary
summary: GK Energy Limited incorporated GK Energy BESS Private Limited on November 25, 2026. The wholly owned subsidiary will focus on energy storage and renewable energy.

headline: Graphite India to hold investor meet with Kotak MF
summary: Graphite India Limited scheduled a virtual meeting with Kotak Mutual Fund on December 1, 2026, to discuss Q2FY27 earnings.

headline: Gamco promoter group member acquires shares
summary: Rashi Goenka, a promoter group member of Gamco Ltd, acquired 11,442 equity shares via open market transactions, raising her holding to 2.86%.

headline: Promoter Roshan Dealmark sells 2 lakh shares in Tavexia
summary: Roshan Dealmark Private Limited, a promoter of Tavexia Lifecare (formerly Sattva Sukun), disposed of 2,00,000 equity shares via on-market trade on November 25, 2026.

headline: Internet Fund VI sells 2.72% stake in Groww
summary: Internet Fund VI Pte. Ltd. sold 17.07 crore equity shares of Groww, reducing its holding to 2.35%. The open market sale occurred between May and November 2026.

headline: Gamco promoter Rajeev Goenka raises stake to 21%
summary: Rajeev Goenka, promoter of Gamco Ltd, acquired 17,000 equity shares via open market on November 23, 2026, increasing his holding to 21.00%.

headline: Sudarshan Chemical to acquire 36.56% in Sudarshan Colorants
summary: Sudarshan Chemical Industries plans to buy 84.4 lakh shares of Sudarshan Colorants from a step-down subsidiary, raising its direct stake to 52.45%.

headline: H.M. Electro Mech H1FY27 EBITDA up 27%
summary: H.M. Electro Mech Ltd reported a 27.4% YoY rise in H1FY27 EBITDA to ₹4.9 crore despite a 6.1% dip in revenue, driven by margin expansion to 15.3%.

headline: Bajaj Auto shares flag large-trade signal on BSE
summary: A large-trade signal flagged ~56,246 Bajaj Auto shares changing hands on BSE at ₹10,821.00, with combined value of ₹60.86 crore. Not a confirmed exchange-reported deal.
